# Check Prime

![Check Prime function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/discrete/05_Check%20Prime_vi.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Returns a Boolean primality result for an I64 integer. Every n&lt;2, including negative values, is False; the magnitude is not substituted. The FROG contract is deterministic on the entire I64 range, not a probabilistic guess. Formula: true iff n is a prime integer &gt;= 2. Example: Check Prime(-7)=False; Check Prime(97)=True; Check Prime(561)=False.

## Types and connection rules

Fixed signature only. Required inputs have no implicit unwired value. No automatic polymorphism, element-wise Array/Cluster lifting, scalar broadcasting or truncation of real values to integers. Wire conversions must follow explicit engine type rules; I64 values must not pass through F64.

- Type resolution: `fixed`; result expression: `bool`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: not accepted; lifting policy: `none`.
- Shape rule: `Exact declared rank-one array values only; Continued Fraction consumes the pair as one expression.`.
- Scalar lifting: no.
- Broadcasting: no.

Arrays are fixed whole-value ports; no element-wise lifting or ragged results.

**Input count:** 1; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `n`.
